prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Hero Journey Redesign: Redesigns the story introduction into a grid layout showcasing hero visuals of available companion paths.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Choose your desktop companion path", "style": "large"}]}}
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Session Persistence Hint: Adds an explanatory hint on the sign-in screen confirming that signing in protects saved pets from resetting across app restarts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in ensures your pet memory and traits are safely saved across restarts."}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Stage Grid Redesign: Replaces the default pet selection list with a clear grid view featuring highlight badges for companion traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Popular Companion", "style": "highlight"}]}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Photo Preview Screen: Inserts a dedicated preview screen after photo upload so users can inspect image clarity before final adoption.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_custom_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_custom_preview": {"headline": "Preview Your Companion", "body": "Verify your uploaded photo features clear lighting and framing before adoption.", "layout": "centered"}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Processing Info: Displays an explanatory status hint reassuring users that pet assets are preparing seamlessly in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Your desktop pet is being prepared in the background. It will launch on your screen shortly.", "show_progress": true}}
5: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Welcome Redesign: Redesigns the final welcome screen into a split view highlighting fundamental desktop pet interaction tips.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Click or drag your pet anytime on your desktop screen.", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Clarity Headline Update: Updates the choose path headline and body text to clearly distinguish between preset library pets and custom creations.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Your Ideal Companion Experience", "body": "Pick between adoption from our pet library or creating a unique custom pet."}}
7: [adoption, hint] Certificate Official Adoption Record Hint: Adds a hint on the adoption certificate screen emphasizing that registration creates a permanent digital pet record.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Your adoption certificate registers your pet's permanent digital identity."}}
8: [finish, copy] Desktop Launch Completion Button Copy: Changes the primary action button label on the final screen to action-oriented text.
   config: {"home_intro": {"button_label": "Summon Pet to Desktop"}}
9: [home, new_flow] Desktop Launch Verification Flow: Adds a verification step right before home intro to check that the desktop pet window renders properly.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_verify", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_verify": {"headline": "Confirm Desktop Visibility", "body": "Ensure your companion window is visible on your primary desktop screen.", "layout": "card"}}

Redesigns the home intro screen layout within onboarding rules.
